'''Flounders''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found in [[temperate]] [[ocean|oceans]] year-round, and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] flounders for their ''strange eyes''.
